cases.name: Ashley Bortner
cases.about: 'I just want everyone to know that she was a beautiful young woman and I was blessed to have her for all the years that I did. She had a smile that would just knock you off your feet,' her mother Tamara Pack said.
cases.narrative: On 11/3/2015, her body was found on fire near railroad tracks and 70% of her body had been burned. She had also been "gagged by clothing, and her face was wrapped with a towel." Her hands and feet were reportedly tied behind her.

cases.name: Valerie Folsom Oakhem
cases.narrative: On 5/26/2023, police found her with severe trauma to her head and face. “The victim was trembling and gasping for air and appeared to be attempting to roll over,” said prosecutors. ADA Jennifer Sprague from the Plymouth County DA’s office said in court that Oakhem was invited in for a glass of wine. It’s unclear what happened next but she says after Oakhem was beaten she suffered in agony for hours before police arrived.
